function: The <area> tag defines an area inside an image map (an image map is an image with clickable areas).

attributes.name: alt
attributes.function: Specifies an alternate text for the area. Required if the href attribute is present

attributes.name: coords
attributes.function: Specifies the coordinates of the area

attributes.name: download
attributes.function: Specifies that the target will be downloaded when a user clicks on the hyperlink

attributes.name: href
attributes.function: Specifies the hyperlink target for the area

attributes.name: hreflang
attributes.function: Specifies the language of the target URL

attributes.name: media
attributes.function: Specifies what media/device the target URL is optimized for

attributes.name: referrerpolicy
attributes.values: no-referrer | no-referrer-when-downgrade | origin | origin-when-cross-origin | same-origin | strict-origin-when-cross-origin | unsafe-url
attributes.function: Specifies which referrer information to send with the link

attributes.name: rel
attributes.values: alternate | author | bookmark | help | license | next | nofollow | noreferrer | prefetch | prev | search | tag
attributes.function: Specifies the relationship between the current document and the target URL

attributes.name: shape
attributes.function: Specifies the shape of the area

attributes.name: target
attributes.function: Specifies where to open the target URL

attributes.name: type
attributes.function: Specifies the media type of the target URL
